handshake: Use this MCP as the shared long-term memory for this assistant project. Start with wiki_discover or wiki_index, then search and retrieve only the context needed. Accepted pages are curated and authoritative. Draft pages require explicit opt-in, are unreviewed, and must not be presented as facts. Use research and discussion workflows to create reviewable knowledge; do not infer or invent missing knowledge.
wiki_discover: Describe the current long-term-memory policy, frontmatter schema, document types, observed tags, collections, and default authority rules.
wiki_index: Return the active navigation index and compact metadata for accepted, curated long-term-memory pages.
wiki_search: Search accepted long-term-memory pages using simple, explainable case-insensitive text matching. Drafts are excluded unless explicitly requested and are always unreviewed.
wiki_get: Get one long-term-memory page by server-issued ID. File paths are never accepted. Clearly identify draft content as non-authoritative.
wiki_submit_note: Save externally supplied context as an unreviewed draft in the wiki inbox for human curation.
wiki_index_resource: The accepted navigation entry point for curated long-term memory.
wiki_schema_resource: The long-term-memory frontmatter schema, status meanings, and authority policy.
wiki_log_resource: The maintenance log for material changes to curated long-term memory.
